case_number: 2024 INSC 500; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 7254 OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP(C) NO. 29334 OF 2016)
summary: Legality of auction proceedings under Maharashtra Land Revenue Code; land revenue arrears enforcement; jurisdiction of Additional Commissioner; validity of auction notices and procedure; whether Order XXI Rule 90 CPC applies to writ proceedings under Article 226; whether Revenue Code Section 247 empowers appellate authority; High Court affirmed Tahsildar's sale certificate; auction conducted after proper notices; respondent's director's alleged NOC authenticity disputed; sale upheld for revenue recovery against mortgaged property.
legal_provisions_cited: Rule 5(1) of Maharashtra Realisation of Land Revenue Rules, 1967
Order XXI Rule 90 Code of Civil Procedure
Rule 13 of Maharashtra Realisation of Land Revenue Rules
Rule 12(2)A of Maharashtra Realisation of Land Revenue Rules
Rule 14(A) of Maharashtra Realisation of Land Revenue Rules
final_judgment: Appeals disposed of by the common judgment and order; the specific relief granted to appellant not explicitly stated in excerpt but High Court judgment rejecting writ petitions affirmed lower order setting aside sale; implied validation of auction proceedings conducted by Tahsildar under Revenue Code.
